title: [model-routing S1] Enforce issue model tier metadata throughout authoring
body:
**Blocked by:** none
**Model tier:** high

## Context
Model tier rationale: This change establishes a cross-process routing and execution contract with failure and concurrency paths.
The user approved the complete model-tier routing plan and authorized implementation, deployment and a bounded live pilot. Work item S1.

## Task
Extend ISSUE_FORMAT with exact second-line metadata, English Context rationale and low/medium/high difficulty rubric. Add a pure parser/CLI and conformance fixtures. Update define-behavior, auditor C6, triage-review-followups, implement-issue skills and follow-up proposal validator so new implementation issues require valid metadata; epics and harvest payloads remain exempt. Assessment disagreements are advisory unless format is provably invalid.

## Touches

- `docs/adr/2026-10-08-issue-metadata-selects-relay-model-tiers.md` — record the issue routing contract.
- .github/ISSUE_FORMAT.md
- .github/scripts/
- .claude/skills/define-behavior/
- .claude/skills/triage-review-followups/
- .bb/skills/implement-issue/

## Scope
### In scope
The mechanism above, its failure-path tests and necessary documentation.
### Out of scope
Per-step model selection, automatic cross-tier fallback, new budget infrastructure and unrelated cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria
- All publishing and readiness paths validate the same metadata contract, preserve Blocked by as physical first line and refuse malformed implementation issues.
- Relevant local verification and CI pass before deployment.
